jobs.employer_name: DIGITEC Financial Technologies and Services GmbH
jobs.description: About the roleJoin us as our Team Lead Technical Operations and help shape the reliability, resilience, and future of DIGITEC’s SaaS operations!DIGITEC is a leading provider of Foreign Exchange SaaS solutions, specializing in FX Swaps, NDFs, and Money Markets. We are looking for an experienced and hands-on Team Lead Technical Operations to lead our TechOps team and ensure the reliable, secure, resilient, and scalable operation of our D3 SaaS platforms.In this role, you will combine technical leadership, people development, and operational ownership, leading a multinational TechOps team of four people based across Hamburg, London, and Singapore. Reporting directly to the CTO, you will play a key role in evolving our operations from manual and infrastructure-centric processes toward a more automated, standardized, observable, and cloud-native environment, applying SRE and Operational Excellence principles.You will work closely with DevOps, Development, Security, Product, and Service Delivery to continuously improve how we operate our platforms and deliver reliable services to our clients.Your ResponsibilitiesTechnical Operations & Reliability- Lead the reliable, resilient, secure, and scalable operation of our D3 SaaS platforms.- Drive service reliability using SRE principles, including SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, observability, and reliability engineering.- Oversee incident, problem, and escalation management while strengthening Business Continuity, Disaster Recovery, and technical resilience.Operational Excellence & Transformation- Drive the evolution toward automated, standardized, observable, and cloud-native operations.- Continuously improve operational processes, tooling, automation, and KPIs to increase reliability and efficiency.- Promote a culture of Operational Excellence, continuous improvement, and effective problem management.Team Leadership & Collaboration- Lead and develop our multinational TechOps team across Hamburg, London, and Singapore, fostering ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning.- Provide technical and operational direction while remaining hands-on where needed.- Work closely with DevOps, Development, Security, Product, and Service Delivery to align priorities, solve operational challenges, and continuously improve our services.Preferred qualifications- Several years of experience operating business-critical SaaS and cloud applications, combined with proven leadership experience in technical teams.- Strong hands-on experience with SRE and Operational Excellence, including observability, SLIs/SLOs, automation, operational KPIs, and continuous improvement.- Solid experience with incident, problem, and escalation management in production environments.- Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, DevOps practices, networking, operating systems, and containerization.- Good knowledge of Business Continuity, Disaster Recovery, technical resilience, and security principles relevant to SaaS operations.- Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.- A hands-on and proactive mindset, with the willingness to understand the technical details of our D3 product family.- Fluent English skills.Nice to haveExperience with one or more of the following would be an advantage:- ITIL certification or practical experience with ITIL-based service management.- Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and Terraform.- Experience with AIOps, operational automation, or cloud-native transformation.- Experience working in regulated environments, ideally financial services.- German language skills.What we offer as an employer- Join an Innovative Leader: Be part of a pioneering SaaS tech company recognised as the global standard in its category, experiencing impressive double-digit annual growth.- Transform a Major Market: Contribute to our mission of revolutionising the FX Swaps market with cutting-edge solutions and technologies.- Be part of an international work force: Work within a truly multi-national team, collaborating with colleagues from across the globe, located in London, Hamburg, and Singapore.- Make an Impact: Hone your skills in small teams where your ideas matter, actively shaping your role and driving your personal growth.- Enjoy Competitive Benefits: Benefit from a competitive compensation and benefits package, including 30 days of annual paid leave.- Invest in Your Development: Access a €1,000 (or equivalent in local currency) yearly budget dedicated to further education and professional development.Our commitment to inclusion:We welcome applications from people of all ages, backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, gender identities, religions and sexual orientations, as well as from disabled and neurodivergent people and people living with chronic conditions.Not sure you tick every box? Apply anyway. We care more about what you can bring than about a perfect match.If anything in our application or interview process could be more accessible for you, just let us know. You don’t need to tell us why, and it won’t affect your application*.*Ergänzende Informationen:Nur schwerbehinderte oder ihnen gleichgestellte PersonenHomeoffice:Umfang: Nach VereinbarungAnforderungen an den Bewerber: Zwingend erforderlich: Customer-Relationship-Management (CRM), Anwendungstechnik, Anwendungsberatung, Kundenberatung, -betreuung

About the Role:As a Performance Specialist, you will operate close to the shopfloor and contribute to the sustainable improvement of equipment as well as process performance within a Production Unit. By driving Continuous Improvement, FOX, AM/PM and Smart Factory initiatives, you will identify performance opportunities, support the implementation of improvement measures and play a key role in strengthening operational excellence and long-term performance results.Main Responsibilities:- Analyze equipment and process losses and identify improvement opportunities to increase Production Unit performance- Support the preparation, facilitation, and follow-up of FOX workshops and Continuous Improvement initiatives- Implement and further develop Lean methodologies and Operational Excellence standards within the Production Unit (PU)- Monitor and track action plans using the PDCA methodology to ensure effective and sustainable implementation- Support the deployment and continuous development of Autonomous and Preventive Maintenance (AM/PM) practices- Contribute to the analysis and improvement of key performance indicators, with a particular focus on OEE and OAE- Support leaders and operational teams in fostering a culture of Continuous Improvement and the adoption of best practicesc- Partner closely with the Production Unit to drive initiatives that improve the efficiency, stability, and productivity of manufacturing processesAbout You:- University degree in Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Production Systems Engineering or a comparable technical field- First professional experience in a manufacturing environment, ideally in Operational Excellence, Continuous Improvement or Lean Management- Knowledge of Lean methodologies such as 5S, Kaizen, SMED, or comparable approaches- Interest in production systems, performance management and digitalization- Strong analytical and structured approach combined with problem-solving skills- High level of initiative, ownership and accountability- Strong communication and teamwork skills- Fluent German and English, both written and spoken

jobs.description:
Work Your Magic with us!

Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.

Position title:

Deutsch

Globaler Business Process Experte (m/w/d) – R2R – Intercompany Accounting -Services

English

global Business Process Expert– R2R – Intercompany Accounting -Services

Berichtet an / Reporting to:

BPO-R2R-SL

Abteilung / Department:

GES – Functional Solution Accounting and Finance – R2R Subledger | EF-DS-GSFS

Arbeitgeber / Arbeitsort /
Company, Place of Work:

Merck KGaA, Darmstadt

Land / Country:

Deutschland / Germany

DETAILLIERTE STELLENBESCHREIBUNG / SPECIFIC JOB DESCRIPTION

Hauptverantwortlichkeiten:

Key Accountabilities:

Ziel der Position:

·          Diese Position spielt eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Steuerung und Optimierung des End-to-End-Prozesses in der Buchhaltung von innerkonzernlichen Verrechnungen von Services, immateriellen Dienstleistungen, dem Verkauf von Bestandteilen des Anlagevermögens sowie dem Ausgleich anderer nicht zum Umlaufvermögen gehörender Rechte und Pflichten (Dividenden, Patentgebühren, Transferpreisanpassungen, etc.) besser bekannt als „Intercompany Accounting- Service“

·          Sie treibt globale, strukturelle Prozessverbesserungen, Standardisierung sowie Automatisierung voran – in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Innovations- und Analytics-Team sowie den Fachbereichen und unterstützenden Funktionen

·          Aufbau zentraler Fähigkeiten innerhalb von GES zu Unterstützung der Unternehmensstrategie und Transformationsinitiativen

Übergeordneter Prozessumfang:

- Gesamtverantwortung für die Prozessoptimierung und Abstimmungsprozesse (Reconciliation), Transformationsinitiativen sowie strategische und geschäftskritische Programme (z. B. ERP).
- Kontinuierliche Bewertung und Verbesserung des End-to-End-Intercompany Accounting -Services mit Fokus auf Automatisierung, Standardisierung und Effizienzsteigerung.
- Implementierung und Unterstützung der Ressourcenplanung.

Geschäftsprozesse (Business Process):

- Definition, Design, Architektur und Implementierung eines globalen End-to-End-Prozessmodells zur Optimierung der Abläufe über alle Organisationseinheiten hinweg (innerhalb und außerhalb von GES).
- örderung von Prozessvereinfachung, Standardisierung/Modularisierung und Automatisierung in enger Abstimmung mit operativen Einheiten, Fachbereichen und unterstützenden Funktionen.
- Steuerung und Sicherstellung geeigneter Prozesse für Business- und Supportfunktionen.
- Identifikation und Implementierung von Best Practices (intern und extern).
- Verantwortung für Tools, Anwendungen, Systeme, Richtlinien und Prozessdesign in enger Zusammenarbeit mit relevanten Stakeholdern.
- Definition und Umsetzung einer Prozess-Governance gemeinsam mit dem BPM-Team, einschließlich: Change-Control-Prozessen, Compliance-Sicherstellung. Dokumentation und Pflege
- Definition von Kontroll- und Risikopunkten sowie Nachverfolgung von Audits
- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Data-Team zur Sicherstellung von Data Governance.

Strategische Initiativen :

- Verantwortung für strategische Initiativen wie ERP-Einführung, Implementierung und Automatisierungsprogramme, sowie Periphere-Lösungen (z.b. Workflows) .
- Leitung von Prozessverbesserungsinitiativen unter Nutzung moderner Technologien und Best Practices zur Effizienzsteigerung.

Performance Management :

- Definition, Steuerung und Pflege von KPIs zur Messung der operativen Performance und Prozessstandardisierung.
- Förderung der Automatisierung und kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung relevanter Reporting-Tools.
- Internes und externes Benchmarking der KPIs.
- Definition und Steuerung von SLAs zu den der operativen Einheiten erbrachten Leistungen des Buchhaltung für die innerkonzernliche Verrechnungen in globaler Abstimmung mit relevanten Stakeholdern.
- Verbesserung von Qualität, Nutzererlebnis und Effektivität entlang des End-to-End-Prozesses.

Erweiterung:

- Verantwortung für die Erweiterung des Leistungsumfangs (horizontal und vertikal), um zusätzliche Services für Business- und Supportfunktionen bereitzustellen
